# `features/resource-assignment`

A resource is shared with or assigned to principals through a dialog.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A resource is shared with or assigned to principals through a dialog.
- **Avoid when:** You are displaying permissions rather than changing them.
- **Consider instead:** `admin/patterns/access`, `features/overlays`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { DefaultDialogContent } from "themelia-ui/features/resource-assignment"
import "themelia-ui/features/resource-assignment.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/action-menu`, `base/buttons`, `base/display`, `base/feedback`, `base/structure`, `base/typography`, `features/overlays`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Public declarations

### `DefaultDialogContent`

Kind: callable.

The dialog body when not replaced: just the picker.

```text
({ SelectorComponent, selectorProps, context, }: SharedResourceCardDialogContentProps<TResource, TSuggestion, TSelectorProps>) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `DefaultDialogSummary`

Kind: callable.

Restates the pending choice above the confirm, since the chosen row may have scrolled
out of sight. Falls back to a `label` field; pass `getSelectionLabel` to be exact.

```text
({ context, strings, getSelectionLabel, }: SharedResourceCardContentProps<TResource, TSuggestion> & { strings?: Partial<typeof defaultSharedResourceCardStrings>; getSelectionLabel?: (selection: TSuggestion) => ReactNode; }) => import("react").JSX.Element | null
```

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Resource assignment — `/resource-assignment`

### With a resource

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<SharedResourceCard<Venue, VenueHit>
  icon={<MapPinIcon />}
  title="Venue"
  resource={venue}
  sections={[{ id: "facts", Component: ({ context }) => <VenueFacts venue={context.resource!} /> }]}
  viewLink={{ href: `/venues/${venue.id}`, label: "Open venue" }}
  selector={{
    title: "Choose a venue",
    confirmText: "Assign venue",
    cancelText: "Cancel",
    SelectorComponent: VenuePicker,
    mapInitialSelected: (venue) =>
      venue ? { id: venue.id, label: venue.name, description: "" } : null,
    getSelectionLabel: (hit) => hit.label,
    onConfirmSelection: async (hit) => { await api.assign(hit.id) },
  }}
/>
```

### With none

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<SharedResourceCard resource={null} selector={…} />
// no selector — the empty state does not pretend there is something to do
<SharedResourceCard resource={null} />
```
